#### Early Career Scholars in Materials Science 2027
The Twelfth Annual  _JMR_ Issue to promote outstanding research by future leaders in materials science.  _JMR_ publishes the latest advances about the creation of new materials and materials with novel functionalities, fundamental understanding of processes that control the response of materials, and development of materials with significant performance improvements relative to state of the art materials.  _JMR_ welcomes papers that highlight novel processing techniques, the application and development of new analytical tools, and interpretation of fundamental materials science to achieve enhanced materials properties and uses. 
!
!
!
> _MRS is an incredible community of scholars, innovators, and engineers driven to have a positive impact on the world through new materials. Being an MRS Member gives me access to forefront research spanning materials synthesis, characterization, and applications. The Spring and Fall MRS conferences are among my favorite annual meetings to connect with the community, and the monthly MRS Bulletin is a great way to stay informed about emerging topics in the interim. The MRS community has provided me with the support, inspiration, and resources to accomplish frontier science throughout my career, and I'm grateful to be an MRS Member!_
Jennifer A. Dionne
Stanford University
Broadening Participation in Materials
The Materials Research Society embraces broadening participation in materials by actively engaging our global membership, supporting the careers of all researchers and investing in community actions that foster a welcoming environment for all.

# University Chapters
]( "Materials Research Society Foundation")The Materials Research Society (MRS) University Chapter Program is a passionate and talented network of students from universities around the world. Supported by the , the program fosters an environment for collaboration and open exchange of ideas across all scientific disciplines, spanning campuses and continents. These students represent the next generation of materials research and are preparing to carry the torch forward, advancing materials and improving the quality of life.
If there is a chapter at your college or university, we urge you to join. If there isn’t a chapter at your location, you may be just the person to get one started. Now’s the time to use your excitement, expertise and unique scientific perspectives to forge a new path. Join this international student community. **Start an MRS University Chapter today!**

# University Chapter Special Projects Program
**Application Submissions Open - November 14**
**Application Deadline - December 15**
Please review the requirements and evaluation criteria below before you start the application process.   
  
!
The MRS University Chapters Special Projects Program was designed to broaden awareness and participation in materials science and engineering both in the MRS University Chapter’s own university and in the broader local community. Through the Special Projects Grant Program, MRS University Chapter students gain valuable professional development experience in grant proposal-writing, organizing materials-related events, honing their teaching and presentation skills, and actively engaging with their community on the topic of materials. 
**Anticipated outcomes and how they will be measured must also be included.**
To obtain funding, a proposal must be prepared by students of the chapter and submitted to MRS by the deadline. 
**Requirements/Evaluation Criteria:** The following provides a guideline to which the proposals will be evaluated against and the requirements as you prepare your proposal for submission:
  * Support for MRS efforts to broaden participation in materials.   
  * Only new initiatives will be considered. Continuation or expansion of a present activity will not be funded.
  * Special Project/Program Name (Note: It should include a reference to how it will Broaden Participation in Materials Science and Engineering)
  * Purpose of the Project/Program and the need it will address
  * An “Executive Summary” that includes a description of how its values broadening participation in materials science and engineering (Up to 75 words)
  * Target audience that will be served
  * Measurable outcomes/deliverables that clearly state how the project/program will broaden participation in materials science and engineering
  * Identify if others offer a similar project/program
  * Total itemized project/program budget
  * Amount requested from MRS Foundation
  * Identify if requested funding is seed, matching or total funds
  * Timeline and plan for a successful completion
The deadline for submitting Special Projects proposals is December 15th of each year. _If the deadline date falls on a weekend, the deadline will be extended to the following Monday._ Upon review of the proposals by the University Chapter Special Projects Review Group, an announcement of selected projects will be made by March of the following year.
A final report which recaps the project/program will be required and a  will be provided.
Please note the following:
  * **Eligibility:** All current, active MRS University Chapter in good standing are eligible
  * **Funding Amount:** $250 - $1000 per project
  * **_Note:_**_Multiple grant requests may be submitted by a single chapter, however, no more than one grant per chapter will be approved_
  * **Evaluation Process:** Reviewed and approved by the MRS Career Advancement Committee
  * **Proposal Deadline:** 11:59 pm ET, December 15 (or next business day) of each year
  * **Grants Announced** : By the end of March of the following year 
* * *
